faqs.q: Sec. 102-280. - Certified cross-connection control technician: Report requirements.
faqs.a:
(a)
Technician.
Every test of a backflow prevention assembly, and every inspection of a non-testable
               assembly or a backflow prevention method, shall be conducted by a certified cross-control
               technician.
(b)
Calibration of equipment.
Each testing gauge used to test a backflow prevention assembly shall be tested and
               calibrated for accuracy at least once annually.
(c)
Submission of reports.
Reports of tests, inspections, repairs, retests, and re-inspections shall be in writing
               and shall be submitted by the testing company or technician to the city by mail, via
               an online city portal, or by email no later than seven days following the test, repair,
               retest, or re-inspection.
(d)
Contents of reports.
A report submitted to the city under this section shall include, but is not limited
               to, the following information:
(1)
Assembly or method type;
(2)
Assembly or method location;
(3)
Assembly make, model, and serial number;
(4)
Assembly size;
(5)
Test date;
(6)
Test results including all results that would justify a pass or fail outcome;
(7)
Certified cross-connection control technician certification agency;
(8)
Technician's certification number;
(9)
Technician's certification expiration date. If a certification has expired, the certification
               is invalid;
(10)
Test kit manufacturer, model, and serial number;
(11)
Test kit calibration date; and
(12)
Whether, and to what extent, the inspected backflow prevention assembly or method
               requires any repair.
(
Ord. No. 4829
, § 1, 12-5-2022)
